description: This walk follows a section of the Berwickshire Coastal Path from Berwick to Eyemouth. The route runs for just over 10 miles, passing along a wonderful cliff top path with wonderful views over the ocean. Route highlights include the photogenic Marshall Meadows Bay and the lovely Burnmouth Bay. You can continue your walking in the other direction on the Berwick to Holy Island Walk .
